text:
jamal: quick q — I'm about to add a short debug dump in payment-svc to help track a race. It may include user_email and request body snippets. ok to ship to infra-logs for a short window?

priya: don't ship raw PII. we need redaction + a TTL and confirmation it's not cached. where are the logs going (kinesis/s3/elk)?

jamal: kinesis -> s3 (infra-redwood-logs), traces go to jaeger. plan was 7d for debug logs. not caching intentionally.

marta: for compliance: no full card numbers ever persisted. card_last4 is fine, emails are PII and must be redacted unless you have an explicit data processing justification. deletion SLA is 3 business days after a verified request.

security-bot: Policy note: logs containing PII must be sanitized before long-term storage. Recommended defaults: debug logs TTL=30d, app logs TTL=90d. See https://go/redwood/sec/log-redaction for guidance.

alex-sre: FYI Redis session cache default TTL=24h. absolutely no full request bodies in cache. if you need a temporary cache, use ephemeral store with <=1h TTL and explicit purge.

jamal: ok — here's the redaction I'm planning to apply in the pipeline:

```json
{"redact": ["email": "(?i)[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\\\\.[A-Z]{2,}", "card_digits": "\\\\b\\\\d{12,19}\\\\b"]}
```

priya: close. two notes: 1) the pipeline expects single-escaped backslashes in the config file (we'll transform for the runtime). 2) don't rely on a naive email regex for edge cases — use the shared redaction lib `redwood-redact` so we get unicode/local parts handled. replace card sequences with `<REDACTED_CARD>`.

jamal: will swap to `redwood-redact` and use the canonical patterns. also will set debug logs TTL=30d (per sec rec). not caching bodies.

priya: also open an access request if you need s3:DeleteObject or temporary elevated read for infra-redwood-logs. tag @ops-approvals and include customer_id and scope (traces vs logs).

jamal: filing OPS ticket now — OPS-1237. requesting temporary s3:DeleteObject for infra-redwood-logs, window 4h, reason: remove debug artifacts for verified customer.

marta: ack. include the customer verification artifact in the ticket and whether the deletion should be recursive across prefixes.

alex-sre: once sec signs off on the ticket I'll run the purge script against the bucket. I can also schedule a lambda to expire matching prefixes if we need repeated runs. :thumbsup:

jamal: thanks — I'll update the ticket with verification and the exact prefixes. plan: land redaction, set TTL=30d for new debug stream, confirm no caching, and post the ticket link here when ready.

deploy-bot: config-lint: basic checks passed for redaction config. manual review by sec required.

priya: thanks — lgtm pending OPS-1237 details and confirmation that `redwood-redact` patterns are used. :white_check_mark:
